source_quote.quote: Patients with a previous histological diagnosis of glioblastoma multiforme, isocitrate dehydrogenase (IDH) wildtype (WT) or astrocytoma, IDH-mutant World Health Organization (WHO) grade IV

coder_notes: Only intervention is an allogeneic mesenchymal stem cell product (cell therapy, excluded type); no pharmacological candidate. Population: IDH-wildtype glioblastoma or IDH-mutant grade 4 astrocytoma (WHO 2021), so mixed glioma with GBM named. IDH status is used only to define eligible histologies (both IDH-wildtype and IDH-mutant allowed), so it is not a true molecular selection; listed for transparency. Correlative tissue/CSF/blood sampling relates to the cell product, not a drug candidate.
